entities.name: EAP result message transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure to provide an EAP-success message or an EAP-failure message, and ngKSI from the network to the UE, when the EAP message cannot be piggybacked by another NAS message.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESULT message
entities.description: NAS message that can initiate the EAP result message transport procedure by carrying the EAP message IE with EAP-success or EAP-failure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message that can initiate the EAP result message transport procedure by carrying the EAP message IE with EAP-failure.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information Element that carries the EAP-success message or EAP-failure message.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: ngKSI (Next Generation Key Set Identifier) provided from the network to the UE as part of the EAP result message transport procedure.

relations.description: The EAP result message transport procedure can be initiated by an AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
The EAP result message transport procedure can be initiated by an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains the EAP message IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message contains the EAP message IE.
EAP message IE can carry an EAP-success message.
EAP message IE can carry an EAP-failure message.
The EAP result message transport procedure provides ngKSI from the network to the UE.
